text=raw.decode(); assert "0.999559608605" in text and "5.999645225074e-13" in text and "Both non-Poisson common-shock controls had\nzero coverage" in text; assert "prior manuscript, not this extended text" in text
print(json.dumps({"status":"actual_scoped_manuscript_integration_verified","new_sections":len(r["inserted_sections"]),"new_local_links":links,"parent_bytes_restored":parent.stat().st_size,"manuscript":r["manuscript"],"native_interval_admission":False}))'
